\section{Coupling}

\section{Circular dependencies}

No cycle exists among module-level imports: the eager import graph is a directed acyclic graph.

Counting deferred imports (function-local imports and imports guarded by \texttt{TYPE\_CHECKING}) as edges, the following components become cyclic:

\begin{itemize}[nosep]
  \item \texttt{factory}, \texttt{jobs}
\end{itemize}

These are not runtime cycles. The deferred import style is the mechanism that keeps them out of the eager graph; see the dependency-direction discussion in this chapter. Reporting them is deliberate: they mark the places where the eager graph is acyclic only because of an import placement decision.
